messages:
Alice Chen: Heads-up — vendors sent revised timelines this morning. H200 slipped ~3 weeks, B200 unchanged, MI300 OEMs are leaning toward late-Oct GA, and Gaudi test images arrived earlier than expected. We need to confirm: (1) marketplace listing/press embargo windows, (2) lab cert capacity, and (3) which SKU variants we surface at GA vs preview. Proposed embargo staging: staggered lift across regions over 2024-10-15 -> 2024-10-29 (EMEA then NA then APAC). Can folks confirm constraints?

Mateo Rivera: Thanks Alice. Can you drop the vendor slide deck? I want to check the H200 parts list and whether any firmware gating is still outstanding. If H200 is delayed we should plan a low-risk canary onto Dedicated for a small customer group.

Priya Kapoor: Noted. Customer launch for one of our early adopters is targeted 2024-10-20 — if we stage marketplace listing across 10/15-10/29 that overlaps. We should avoid a full public marketplace listing before 10/21 for customers on Dedicated. Suggest: marketplace preview flag for GA SKUs on 10/15, public listing on 10/22.

Dan O'Neill: Lab capacity reality check: our PXN lab has 12 slots for cert runs/week. If MI300 GA pushes to late Oct we can batch MI300 runs into two intensive weeks, but that will push H200 certs out. Current backlog: 8 H200 preflight images, 5 MI300 images, 3 Gaudi images. Recommendation: prioritize MI300 (enterprise demand + OEM SLA), run H200 on a rolling canary schedule. I can free up 4 extra slots if we pause non-critical ops.

Ravi Singh: I'm on with vendors this afternoon to ask for a narrower embargo window. Early ask: can NVIDIA provide a select-partner preview build with a 7-day preview before wider embargo lift? If yes, we can do partner-enabled Dedicated canaries and minimize customer impact. Also negotiating earlier Gaudi test pods for Marketplace listing smoke tests.

Mateo Rivera: If we do partner-preview builds we need a mapping doc for fallback images: when H200 not available fallback to B200 quantized profile X, MI300 fallback to MiGPU-lite. We should commit to a 2-week fallback policy to avoid surprises for customers. I'll draft matrix.

Priya Kapoor: Agree on fallback matrix. Also: marketing needs an embargo date by EOD Friday to align PR and marketplace banners. If vendors can't commit, we delay the public PR.

Dan O'Neill: Actionable numbers: I can allocate the 4 extra slots for MI300 during week of 2024-10-21 if Ravi secures mini-preview by 10/10. Otherwise MI300 shifts to 10/28 heavy run.

Ravi Singh: I'll push vendors for 10/10 preview cutoff. Also flagging potential SKU mismatch: some vendor SKUs use different device IDs which break our marketplace image naming. Need eng-runtime to approve tolerant image tags.

Alice Chen: Good threads. Action items: (A) Mateo — fallback mapping doc (due 10/08). (B) Dan — lab run replan and capacity spreadsheet (due 10/09). (C) Ravi — vendor preview ask + confirmation of device IDs (due 10/10). (D) Priya — hold PR calendar until we get an embargo decision; provide marketing a tentative 10/22 public listing date (due 10/08). Release-bot: please create calendar block for vendor embargo review on 2024-10-11 10:00 PT.

release-bot: Created event "Vendor Embargo Review" on 2024-10-11 10:00 PT. Invited participants: Alice Chen, Mateo Rivera, Priya Kapoor, Dan O'Neill, Ravi Singh.

Mateo Rivera: I'll start the fallback doc now and ping runtime for tolerant tags.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks — will pause marketing assets until we have the confirmed embargo window. :thumbsup:

Dan O'Neill: I'll post the lab capacity sheet in #eng-infra and tag this thread.

Ravi Singh: Will report vendor answer by end of day 10/10. If they refuse preview, we default to the 10/28 heavy run plan and update marketing accordingly.
